title: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients
why_read: A notable early-stage clinical result in oncolytic virus therapy for pancreatic cancer, interesting mainly to readers tracking biotech rather than software engineering.
analysis: This describes a small clinical case series where an oncolytic virus injection appeared to halt pancreatic cancer progression in three patients. It's a legitimate and exciting area of cancer research, but with only three patients, it is far from a proven therapy and requires much larger trials to confirm safety and efficacy. For a software-engineering-focused digest, this is tangential, though some readers interested in biotech or computational biology may appreciate it. The engagement reflects the general public health interest rather than technical software content.
